classes.name: Sekai
classes.description: Canonical operational memory: typed objects and relations for actors, operations, attempts, actions, artifacts, verification, and outcomes; graph traversal, lineage, schema validation, audit trails, and namespace-first access control. Domain concepts belong in schemas and adapters, not the core contract.

classes.name: Chisei
classes.description: Governed decision layer that resolves how an operation may proceed: allowed runtimes and models from namespace policy; budgets, egress, action policy, and approval; memory and risk enrichment; evaluation and outcome attribution. Policy choices stay inspectable instead of buried in an agent runtime.

classes.name: Portable Ontology Database
classes.description: A local SQLite ontology file selected with --db or SEKAI_DB, commonly .sekai/knowledge.db. It stores portable class, relation, and provenance documents for the sekai CLI. It is not the control-plane runtime database.

classes.name: Control Plane Database
classes.description: The sekai-chisei runtime store, defaulting to data/sekai.db. It holds operational graph state for the gRPC control plane and must not be used as a portable ontology database.

classes.name: Receipt
classes.description: The authoritative operation projection returned by GetOperationReceipt. Reconciliation uses the receipt; it records the bound operation identity, events, and outcome on the harvest spine.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: A governed run correlated by operation_id across plan, execute, events, and receipt. GetOperationReceipt is the stable read of that run.

classes.name: Governed Action
classes.description: A submitted ActionInstance against a registered GovernedActionType. Admission persists the instance with a bound operation_id. Deliberate execution stays SubmitActionInstance; describe and preview are observational and are not submit authority.

classes.name: Directory Fact
classes.description: A local filesystem entity or contains link recorded by directory init and directory index in a portable ontology database. Directory facts record workspace layout; they are not ontology classes.

classes.name: Ontology Class
classes.description: An explicit portable definition of meaning: name, description, superclasses, properties, and provenance. Classes describe types above durable facts; they are not directory index rows and are not server builtins unless separately applied through the control plane.

relations.name: governs_through
relations.description: Chisei decisions constrain operations whose durable facts live in Sekai. The two layers are one control plane, not separate products.

relations.name: distinct_from
relations.description: The portable ontology file selected with --db or SEKAI_DB is not the control-plane database at data/sekai.db.

relations.name: records
relations.description: A receipt is the authoritative projection of one operation.

relations.name: submitted_as
relations.description: A governed Action binds an ActionInstance to the operation receipt spine. SubmitActionInstance admits; GetOperationReceipt reconciles.

relations.name: binds
relations.description: Admission persists a governed Action with a bound operation_id for the existing operation receipt and harvest spine.

relations.name: is_not
relations.description: A directory fact records filesystem layout; an ontology class defines meaning. Do not treat directory index rows as ontology classes.
